relationship: Different economic evaluations
evidence: Different author teams: Sathianathen et al. versus Sung et al. The earlier analysis compares three treatment strategies; the later compares five and reaches a different preferred-treatment result. The later paper cites the earlier as previous research.
suggested_handling: Retain both as separate evaluations.

relationship: Conference abstract and full article
evidence: Overlapping Schuetz/Sulo/Walzer author team; same EFFORT trial, 2,028 participants (1,015/1,013), 30-day model, CHF214 saving and CHF19.56 after dietitian costs. Crossref identifies MON-LB676 as the conference report.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; full article is the preferred report.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same Cochrane review identifier CD009261. Publisher update metadata links pub5 to pub4. Searches advance from June 2019 to January 2021; RCT count rises from 44 to 62 and economic studies from five to six.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; decide whether the map counts each update or only the latest review.

relationship: ATTILA trial conference report and HTA
evidence: Same named trial, 495 participants, 248/247 allocation and assistive-technology comparison. Crossref identifies the earlier record as P4-628 and overlapping Gathercole/Howard authors. HTA adds fuller economic and caregiver reporting.
suggested_handling: Link study family; use the HTA for economic details.

relationship: Country-specific economic analyses using the same trial
evidence: Both use CRYSTAL-AF, with some overlapping authors, but the 2016 model uses a UK NHS perspective and the later model uses US costs and adds immediate versus delayed monitoring strategies.
suggested_handling: Retain both evaluations; a common trial does not make the economic analyses duplicates.

relationship: Separate evaluations of the Shanghai screening programme
evidence: Li et al. model annual screening of a hypothetical population of 100,000 using 3.5% discounting; Jiang et al. use 2014-2016 real-world programme data (1,097,656 residents) and 3% discounting. Different author lists, cohort definitions and cost-effectiveness estimates.
suggested_handling: Retain both economic analyses; optionally link the shared programme.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same identifier CD001800, publisher new-version link from pub4 to pub3, and the 2021 abstract explicitly updates the 2016 review with searches through 2020/2021.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; apply an explicit review-update counting policy.

relationship: NBER working paper and published article
evidence: Same Goodman-Bacon author and Medicaid implementation design. NBER explicitly lists the 2021 American Economic Review article as the published version of working paper 22899.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal version.

relationship: NBER working paper and published article
evidence: Identical five-author team and 18-month Malawi chlorine-coupon experiment. NBER explicitly lists the 2023 journal article as the published version of working paper 27570.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal version.

relationship: Possible shared trial/protocol; conflicting reported cohorts
evidence: Full texts share Shenglong Li, the Liaoning institution, protocol CMU/CL/12/15 and recruitment starting January 2015. However, the 2019 paper reports 250 patients recruited through January 2016; the 2022 paper reports 160 recruited through January 2018 with broader eligibility and different results. Neither supplies an explicit version link to the other. The 2019 paper is retracted.
suggested_handling: Do not merge automatically. Resolve whether these are revised/subset data or separate cohorts; consider the retracted record separately under a retraction policy.

relationship: Early-online and issue-publication records of the same article
evidence: RIS provides the same four Liu/Zhan/Liu/Chen authors and journal. Abstracts describe the identical 92 patients recruited January 2017-August 2021, the same 46/46 comparison and outcomes. The earlier abstract labels itself ahead of print; PubMed identifies the 2024 issue record, PMID 38064624.
suggested_handling: Treat as duplicate records of one article; prefer the complete issue citation.

relationship: Updated Ontario health technology assessment
evidence: Same HTA subject but 2016 searches end in 2014 and find insufficient evidence; the 2024 assessment contains updated evidence, a new model (ICER CAD57,314/QALY) and new budget/equity analyses. RIS confirms distinct Ontario HTA volumes 16(1) and 24(2).
suggested_handling: Link assessment lineage; retain as separate assessment editions unless latest-only is the chosen policy.

relationship: Conference/full-article metadata mixed with a later journal synopsis
evidence: Both corpus abstracts reproduce the same BRCA1 model: 1,429,074 pregnancies, 3,716 carriers, 1,394 prevented cancers, 1,084 prevented deaths and ICER USD86,001/QALY. Crossref says the 2025 Survey report is abstracted from the 2024 full article. Record 131462474 instead stores a conference DOI (10.1016/j.ajog.2023.11.454); its full-article abstract matches 10.1016/j.ajog.2024.04.014.
suggested_handling: Link the same evaluation, flag the synopsis as secondary reporting, and repair DOI/report provenance before choosing the canonical record.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same identifier CD007491 and explicit publisher pub3-to-pub2 update. Searches change from 2016 to 2022; included trials increase from 16 (1,814 participants) to 20 (3,100).
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; apply a review-update counting policy.

relationship: NBER working paper and published article
evidence: Same Ganimian/Muralidharan/Walters team and ICDS staffing experiment. NBER explicitly lists the 2024 Journal of Political Economy article as the published version of paper 28780.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal version.

relationship: Likely trial registration and results article
evidence: RIS identifies record 132884066 as TCTR20221219005. The registry abstract has planned interventions and outcomes but no results. Its distinctive title, tissue-adhesive/suture comparison, 2/6-week outcomes and cost endpoint match the 120-patient article. The accessible article does not explicitly state this registry number.
suggested_handling: Probable trial-family link; verify the registration-to-paper identity before consolidation. The registry record is not a second completed evaluation.

relationship: medRxiv preprint and published article
evidence: Same five authors, 11 Colombian cities, 10-year model, Cali saving USD4.95/person, 369 DALYs averted/100,000, and benefit-cost ratios 5.50/4.68. The article and preprint describe the same economic analysis.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the published article.

relationship: Conference abstract and revised full economic analysis
evidence: Identical eight-author team and pooled GAIN/GAP70/INTEGERATE/5C model, Canadian payer perspective, six-month horizon and trial-specific scenarios. Conference INMB CAD1,117 (70.7% probability) changes to CAD599 (60.9%) in the article.
suggested_handling: Link as the same evaluation with revised results; use the final article rather than pooling estimates.

relationship: Conference abstract and revised results article
evidence: 2023 DOI identifies a CUA meeting poster collection containing this MV140 analysis. Both abstracts have the same Canadian 1.25-year, four-state model versus prophylactic antibiotics. Base-case implementation and savings change between reports.
suggested_handling: Link the evaluation; retain final results and the exact poster citation.

relationship: Separate Korean and US economic models
evidence: 2019 model uses Korean insurance claims and gives ICER USD9,707/QALY; the 2012 model uses US payer/Medicare costs and ROCKET-AF inputs, giving USD27,498/QALY. Different populations, data and costs.
suggested_handling: Retain both as separate evaluations.

relationship: Chilean working paper and journal article
evidence: RIS identifies the earlier report as Chilean Economics working paper 382 by Dominguez/Harrison/Atal, matching journal authors. Both have a 20-year Markov model, USD28,000 direct savings and USD102,000 including quality of life.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal article.

relationship: English and Italian reports of the same NICE appraisal
evidence: Identical eight authors in Crossref. The 2013 publisher title is Italian, although the corpus uses an English translation. Abstracts describe the same ERG reanalysis and identical GBP2,500-6,200 and GBP19,000 ICERs.
suggested_handling: Link as translated/republished appraisal reporting; use one economic evaluation.

relationship: Parallel reports of the same valve-replacement evaluation
evidence: RIS Iranian-journal authors overlap the international article. Both describe 30 patients per arm at Imam-Khomeini hospital in 2000-2005, identical SF-36 scores 66.06/57.85 and 0.67 QALY difference. Savings are expressed in different currencies. Crossref also distinguishes 2009 online publication from the 2011 issue year.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; verify language/citation details and apply a consistent year rule.

relationship: Republication/abstract of an Argentine study in a Chilean journal
evidence: Same Lenz/Vassallo team and identical Garrahan trial results. The 2012 publisher page explicitly describes regional republication of selected pediatric papers and cites the original 2010 Argentine journal report.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the original full report.

relationship: Cochrane review update with no new included trial
evidence: Same identifier CD001917; publisher new-version link from pub4 to pub3. Search moves from 2011 to 2015, but both abstracts retain the same single trial. A rerun search is still a new review edition, not a conference/full-paper pair.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; latest-only policy could consolidate these editions.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same identifier CD007293 and publisher pub4-to-pub3 update. Search dates move from December 2011 to June 2018 and certainty/reporting is updated.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; apply a review-update counting policy.

relationship: Probable secondary reproduction of the same Ginkgo economic analysis
evidence: Both corpus abstracts report the same 1,201-patient meta-analysis, 22.3-month delay, EUR3,692-29,577 savings and EUR530.88 per additional success. Crossref identifies different author attribution (Rainer/Mucke/Schlaefke versus Klement) and different German-language publication venues. These support overlap but do not establish an authorized translation or exact republication.
suggested_handling: Probable same-evaluation link; inspect the German secondary article before treating it as a duplicate version.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same CD004305 identifier and publisher pub5-to-pub4 update. Search moves from April 2012 to September 2016 and the cost-effectiveness synthesis is refreshed.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; apply a review-update counting policy.

relationship: Same Cochrane review reproduced in another journal
evidence: Overlapping Gomes/Calanzani/Curiale/McCrone/Higginson/de Brito author team. Both abstracts use the same November 2012 search, seven-trial home-death pooled result and six-study inconclusive economic evidence. Later DOI is in Sao Paulo Medical Journal rather than a new Cochrane edition.
suggested_handling: Link as secondary reporting of one review; use the original Cochrane report.

relationship: Conference abstract and full Li-Tho trial report
evidence: Same four authors; 100 lobectomy patients, identical LigaSure versus stapler randomization, Pareto analysis and postoperative findings. Crossref identifies earlier B-006 conference abstract.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the full article.

relationship: Chilean working paper and journal article
evidence: RIS identifies working paper 383 with the same four Dominguez/Harrison/Atal/Larrain authors. Both estimate Chilean organ-donation policies with identical six-extra-donor savings (USD1.9 million direct; USD15 million including quality of life) and four-donor break-even point.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal article. This is separate from the transplant valuation in group 21.

relationship: SSRN working paper and journal article
evidence: Matching six-author team (order changes), food-tax demand/health uncertainty method, sugar-tax effects and distributional conclusions. Later article is the expanded publication of this analysis.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal article.

relationship: Conference abstract and revised full article
evidence: Overlapping Coyle/Grunfeld team and identical 408-patient breast-cancer survivorship RCT, two-year societal analysis and QALYs 1.42/1.41. Costs and cost-effectiveness probability change slightly in the full report.
suggested_handling: Link the same evaluation; use final article estimates.

relationship: Full article and later conference presentation
evidence: Identical seven authors, Irish hospital RCT 361/376 participants, EUR807 saving, 0.064 fewer ADRs and the same cost-effectiveness probabilities. Conference publication occurs after the full article.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; retain the full article. Do not assume the later year is the preferred report.

relationship: Cochrane review update
evidence: Same CD004242 identifier and publisher pub5-to-pub4 update. Search advances from 2011 to 2015; this is an updated synthesis of day-case versus inpatient cataract surgery.
suggested_handling: Link review lineage; apply a review-update counting policy.

relationship: Conference abstract and full trial-based evaluation
evidence: Overlapping Moojen/Peul/Vleggeert-Lankamp authors, same 159-patient Dutch trial, first-year societal costs, EUR3,030 healthcare difference and EUR2,762 societal difference. Utility tariff details differ between preliminary and final reports.
suggested_handling: Link the evaluation; prefer the full article and preserve the version-specific utility assumptions.

relationship: Repeated conference reporting of the same transplant evaluation
evidence: Overlapping Gheith/Halim/Al-Otaibi team; identical 201 recipients, 100/101 groups, doses 450/900 mg, six-month prophylaxis and one-year follow-up. Costs and leukopenia results match. However, the first record combines the 2017 full-paper abstract with a 2015 conference DOI; the matching full paper is 10.6002/ect.mesot2016.P34.
suggested_handling: Link the evaluation and flag mixed DOI/abstract/year provenance; identify the intended report before consolidation.

relationship: Conference abstract and full RIVUR economic analysis
evidence: Same Palmer/Seideman/Lotan team and decision-tree analysis. Both report costs USD3,092/2,932, 12.7 fewer infections per 100, and identical USD386, 32%, 63% and 48% sensitivity thresholds.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the full article.

relationship: Withdrawn article record and surviving publication of the same analysis
evidence: Same eight authors and virtually identical abstracts: MISCAN-Colon, 76 screening strategies, 79% prevented colorectal-cancer deaths and the same recommended starting ages. Crossref marks DOI 10.1053/j.gastro.2017.12.011 as WITHDRAWN and records publisher withdrawal metadata; the other DOI identifies the complete 2018 article.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation and flag the withdrawn record; prefer 10.1053/j.gastro.2017.10.036.

relationship: Conference abstract and full helmet-ventilation cost analysis
evidence: Overlapping Kyeremanteng/Gagnon team and same Patel trial. Both report ICU/hospital savings USD2,527/3,103, 43.3% intubation reduction and identical annual projections.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the full article.

relationship: Conference abstract and revised full nivolumab evaluation
evidence: Overlapping Raphael/Sun/Bjarnason/Sander/Naimark authors; same CheckMate-025 model, Canadian payer and Ontario costs. Annual discount rate changes from 5% to 3%, explaining why QALMs, costs and ICERs differ.
suggested_handling: Link the same evaluation; use final article estimates and note the revised assumptions.

relationship: NBER working paper and published article
evidence: Same Chan/Chen authors and Veterans Health Administration emergency-department design. NBER explicitly lists the 2026 American Economic Review article as the published version of paper 30608.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal version.

relationship: NBER working paper and published article
evidence: Same Zeltzer/Einav/Rashba/Balicer team and Israeli telemedicine study. NBER explicitly lists the 2024 journal article as the published version of paper 28978.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the journal version.

relationship: Two preprint platforms reporting the same analysis
evidence: Overlapping Dorn/Khailaie team and essentially identical German COVID-19 integrated model abstracts, including reproduction-number optimum 0.75. Crossref also links the medRxiv report to journal DOI 10.1007/s10198-022-01452-y, outside this title group.
suggested_handling: Link the preprint reports; check for the final journal version when selecting a canonical publication.

relationship: Unrelated dissertations with a generic title
evidence: RIS identifies the 2016 Wisconsin dissertation as Ryne William Marksteiner, covering grant aid, faculty demographics and spousal substance-use spillovers. The other record describes Medicaid/Medicare dynamics and flexible work/study; Crossref attributes its DOI to Ferrell and titles it Three Essays in Public Economics. It is not the same thesis.
suggested_handling: Retain as separate records; verify the second dissertation DOI/year because its metadata is sparse.

relationship: Working paper and conference report of the same evaluation
evidence: RIS identifies a 2015 CERDI working paper by Yakhelef/Audibert/Pereira/Mons/Chabert; later DOI is a EUROSPINE abstract collection. Both abstracts describe 99 randomized patients with identical cost totals, QALY difference 0.01 and three perspective-specific ICERs.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; locate the individual abstract within the proceedings citation.

relationship: Two working-paper/preprint platforms for one NHS analysis
evidence: Same Gaynor/Moreno-Serra/Propper authors and English 2006 competition reform analysis. NBER also identifies a 2013 journal version, whereas the 2013 included candidate uses an SSRN DOI.
suggested_handling: Link the working-paper records; do not label the SSRN record as the journal article.

relationship: Conference abstract and full LIGRO trial economic analysis
evidence: Overlapping Hasselgren/Henriksson team, same 100-patient ALPPS/TSH trial and two-year Swedish economic analysis. Cost difference 12,662, QALY difference 0.1285 and ICER 93,186 match exactly.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; prefer the full article.

relationship: Conference abstract and full Hungarian boceprevir model
evidence: Identical five-author team, payer model and trials. QALY gains 0.59/1.13 and both HUF ICERs are identical; a few clinical-event figures differ slightly in the final article.
suggested_handling: Link the same evaluation; prefer final article estimates.

relationship: Two conference reports of the SARAH trial evaluation
evidence: Overlapping Heine/Williams/Lamb team and same 17-trust English hand-exercise trial and 12-month economic evaluation. Later report changes intervention costing and ICER; this is repeated/revised trial reporting, not a second independent RCT. The full HTA is separately included as record 131941353, DOI 10.3310/hta19190, with the same 490 patients and trial design.
suggested_handling: Link the study family and existing HTA; retain report-specific economic estimates rather than treating both abstracts as independent studies.

relationship: Repeated conference reporting, with one incorrect DOI
evidence: Both candidate abstracts describe the same 1,180-woman Swedish equivalence trial and identical EUR44/58 direct costs, EUR11 complication saving and EUR-9/-18 ICERs. RIS supplies the Sjostrom/Kopp-Kallner/Simeonova/Madestam/Gemzell-Danielsson team for the 2015 abstract. The 2016 candidate DOI actually identifies an unrelated conscientious-objection article. The full economic paper is separately included as record 131977666 (PLOS DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0158645), with revised final estimates.
suggested_handling: Link by study evidence, flag the incorrect DOI, and include the existing full paper in the study family. Do not replace the conference DOI with the full-paper DOI without deciding which report this record represents.

relationship: Repeated conference reporting of the same droxidopa model
evidence: 2015 DOI is a poster collection and 2016 DOI is a specific Neurology conference poster. Both use NOH306 trial data and report exactly USD30,112 drug costs, USD14,574 savings, ICER USD47,001/QALY and identical fall-specific ICERs.
suggested_handling: Link as one evaluation; retain exact individual-poster provenance.

relationship: Repeated conference reporting of the same RxEACH economic model
evidence: Both DOIs identify conference collections, rather than individual full articles. Abstracts report the same Canadian 30-year model, 1.5% discounting, USD/CAD4.6-billion saving, 592,049 QALYs and nine-million avoided events. A full revised economic paper is separately included as record 131121257, DOI 10.1177/1715163519851822.
suggested_handling: Link both conference reports and the existing full article; use the final article for estimates.

relationship: Confirmed trial registration and results conference abstract
evidence: RIS identifies TCTR20220720007 and the results abstract explicitly repeats that identifier. It reports 98 kidney recipients randomized 49/49. The registry only states planned outcomes. A separately included full article, record 132297933, repeats the same trial and exact infection counts and testing costs.
suggested_handling: Link the registry, abstract and full article; assess the registry as a registration record rather than a completed economic evaluation.

relationship: Six records cover five trials, including one related pair
evidence: Crossref supplies specific titles despite the corpus title Public Health. Records describe MYB in Australia (132885538/132928004), DelpHi-MV in Germany (132885614), J-MINT in Japan (132885799), SMART4MD in Sweden/Spain (132889729) and AGELESS in Malaysia (132889811). Only the MYB pair is linked within this group: economic evaluation versus broader trial overview, with the same three-year intervention and cognitive effect 0.18. DelpHi-MV also links across groups to 132885613.
suggested_handling: Split the generic-title group into five study families. Link MYB companion reports, restore specific titles and preserve distinct economic analyses.

relationship: Different dementia trials sharing a conference section heading
evidence: Crossref resolves actual titles. Record 132885613 is the German DelpHi-MV collaborative-care trial (428 economic-analysis participants; 36 months). Record 132889609 is UK NIDUS-Family (302 dyads; 12 months; ISRCTN11425138). They are unrelated evaluations.
suggested_handling: Retain both; restore individual titles. Link DelpHi-MV to the subgroup report in group 55.

relationship: Probable revised/repeated conference analysis
evidence: Both abstracts use 2010-2017 Medicare claims, the same ten BPCI episode groups and factorial-style comparison with identical non-BPCI count 1,268,933. Participating physician counts and effect estimates change materially, so exact duplication is not established. Public conference programmes show the same presentation topic in 2021/2022. A related final paper is included as 131377387 but extends claims to 2018 and reports medical/surgical effects separately.
suggested_handling: Link as a probable study family, retain version-specific estimates, and verify the extent of reanalysis before collapsing publications.
